name: King's Town Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: King's Town Construction Co., Ltd. is a prominent real estate developer operating within Taiwan. The company undertakes the full spectrum of property activities, including the development, construction, leasing, and sale of various assets. These include specialized commercial properties, business premises, residential dwellings, and associated parking facilities. Beyond its core construction endeavors, King's Town Construction diversifies its operations into the hospitality sector, managing hotels and restaurants. Additionally, it offers specialized services in zoning and land-use planning consultancy. Established in 1982, the firm was initially known as Wei Cheng Construction Co., Ltd. Its headquarters are situated in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
